body.title: Reconcile daemon RPC registration and audit coverage
body.reproduction: Handler-runtime, repo-call-audit/table, repo-gate-dispatch, method-class and daemon-doc-repo-table tests disagree with current handlers. Examples include daemon.qualificationState and design-review-step.cancel missing reviewed classification, newer cancellation keys absent from snapshots, and a fixed minimum count of modifying methods.
body.rootCause: Several independent literal inventories and documentation tables were not reconciled with additions and review retirement. Some tests rely on historical counts instead of checking the actual supported handler set; classification omissions must still be assessed as real scoping/routing gaps.
body.fixIntent: Make every registered RPC/stream/step phase have an explicit correct classification, repository-scoping rule and documented contract, then validate exact coverage against constructed handler tables. Preserve refusal behavior and ownership boundaries; do not simply whitelist unknown methods or reduce assertions to counts. Acceptance: runtime, routing, audit and documentation key sets agree with no stale or unclassified entry. Review endpoint behavioral replacement remains in batch 04.
